title: autospec-fleet node-local capacity
description: Schema for ~/.autospec/fleet-node.yml, the private per-node capacity file. It declares node identity, local workspace placement, runnable profiles, and concurrency limits.

node_id.description: Stable node identifier used in fleet worker IDs and status files.

workspace.description: Node-local checkout directory. Overrides the shared desired-state workspace on this node.

max_parallel_repos.description: Maximum number of repository workers this node may run concurrently.

profiles.description: Model profiles this node is allowed to run.
